integrity: The ideal list and adjacency conditions follow directly from divisor ideals in the integer residue ring. The upper bound is an explicit chronological forcing sequence. The lower bound is an explicit complete minor together with standard width/forcing inequalities.
scientific_limitations: The modulus has exactly two distinct prime divisors, with one exponent equal to one.
The theorem does not classify every minimum zero forcing set.
No real minimum-rank or maximum-nullity equality is asserted.
The graph recovers the repeated-prime exponent but not the prime values.
title: Zero forcing, treewidth, and pathwidth of semiprime-power annihilating-ideal graphs
